strbuild/ — the std strbuild pkg's bench row: churn (one small-hint
builder through geometric grows) plus the per-fragment-mint build
shape, the checksum folded over counts + sampled content. A module
dir because it mounts `strbuild` (which pulls the `strbuild_host`
host pkg through its own [deps]); `pouch` for the fragment table,
`ink` for the logger. The pkg name carries the `_bench` suffix — the
root's name must not collide with the mounted `strbuild` pkg it
deps. The JS twin is ../strbuild.js.
name: strbuild_bench
